guidedTourSteps.label: Investor snapshot
guidedTourSteps.trigger: Open the product for the first time
guidedTourSteps.outcome: Understand the market problem, product scope, and rollout plan in under one minute.

guidedTourSteps.label: Secure onboarding
guidedTourSteps.trigger: Create users and send first-login access
guidedTourSteps.outcome: Each employee enters through role-based access, 2FA, and audit-friendly sessions.

guidedTourSteps.label: Project setup
guidedTourSteps.trigger: A new construction job is awarded
guidedTourSteps.outcome: The portal creates one source of truth for BOQ, phases, deadlines, team members, and progress.

guidedTourSteps.label: Daily field capture
guidedTourSteps.trigger: Work is completed on site today
guidedTourSteps.outcome: Supervisor input becomes an engineer-verified official report with photos and attachments.

guidedTourSteps.label: Management approval
guidedTourSteps.trigger: A report, document, material request, or invoice needs sign-off
guidedTourSteps.outcome: Approvals move through the right chain with comments, reminders, escalation, and audit records.

guidedTourSteps.label: Inventory & Stores
guidedTourSteps.trigger: Materials or tools move between warehouse and project site stores
guidedTourSteps.outcome: Warehouse/site stock, tagged tool location, approvals, suppliers, invoices, and costs become governed workflows instead of spreadsheets.

guidedTourSteps.label: Mobile execution
guidedTourSteps.trigger: Users work from site on low bandwidth
guidedTourSteps.outcome: A PWA-friendly flow keeps drafts, photos, approvals, and notifications usable on phones.

guidedTourSteps.label: Launch path
guidedTourSteps.outcome: The team has an MVP scope, acceptance scenarios, migration inputs, and deployment model.

productTourSteps.title: Read the operations pulse
productTourSteps.body: The operations pulse provides a live management view of company-wide KPIs, approval status, late updates, and risk signals.
productTourSteps.instruction: Approved field activity immediately updates KPIs, pending approvals, late updates, and document risk on the dashboard.

productTourSteps.title: Understand the business problem
productTourSteps.body: Garrisons replaces scattered WhatsApp updates, manual spreadsheet tracking, unclear approvals, and document folder confusion with one unified operating flow.
productTourSteps.instruction: Field updates, approvals, documents, and materials move through governed workflows instead of chat threads and email inboxes.

productTourSteps.title: See the executive value
productTourSteps.body: Features translate directly into measurable operating outcomes: reporting speed, approval discipline, document trust, cost visibility, and mobile field adoption.
productTourSteps.instruction: The portal serves as a management operating layer that connects field execution to executive visibility.

productTourSteps.title: Follow the business flow
productTourSteps.body: The operating flow connects project baseline, site field capture, engineer verification, PM approval, and the final company record.
productTourSteps.instruction: Every feature connects to this core operating flow: project baseline, field capture, verification, approval, and company record.

productTourSteps.title: Confirm requirements coverage
productTourSteps.body: Every documented module is mapped to current coverage and final-product behavior so nothing is missed.
productTourSteps.instruction: All 13 documented modules are covered with clear scope: MVP, Phase 2, Phase 3, and Operations.

productTourSteps.title: Secure first login
productTourSteps.body: New users enter through a controlled sign-in flow with email, password, and 2FA.
productTourSteps.instruction: Admin creates accounts, sends access credentials, and users complete secure first-login with mandatory password change and 2FA before role-based access opens.

productTourSteps.title: See role-based permissions
productTourSteps.body: Each screen operates with a defined owner, trigger, user action, system action, and measurable business result.
productTourSteps.instruction: Every module has clear ownership, activation triggers, required user actions, automated system behavior, and defined business outcomes.

productTourSteps.title: Track operational KPIs
productTourSteps.body: The dashboard summarizes active projects, pending approvals, late updates, documents, low stock, and unread alerts.
productTourSteps.instruction: Managers receive live risk signals without waiting for manual spreadsheet updates or chat follow-ups.

productTourSteps.title: Review project progress
productTourSteps.body: Project cards let managers switch between jobs and inspect progress, budget, deadlines, delayed reports, and discipline progress.
productTourSteps.instruction: Select any project to view detailed progress, budget status, discipline breakdown, and timeline in a consistent workflow structure.

productTourSteps.title: Create the project baseline
productTourSteps.body: Each project starts with a unique code, BOQ import or manual entry, milestones, assigned members, deadlines, and progress rules.
productTourSteps.instruction: All reports, WIRs, costs, documents, and approvals connect back to this project baseline.

productTourSteps.title: Understand BOQ and Gantt logic
productTourSteps.body: The Gantt timeline tracks phase planning, task owners, progress status, and delay visibility.
productTourSteps.instruction: Each task has an owner, timeline span, and real-time status that connects directly to BOQ-approved progress calculations.

productTourSteps.title: Walk the daily report chain
productTourSteps.body: Supervisor updates become engineer-verified daily reports, then move to PM approval and automated PDF, email, and archive.
productTourSteps.instruction: Field data captured by the supervisor becomes an engineer-verified, PM-approved official company record with PDF export and audit trail.

productTourSteps.title: See required report inputs
productTourSteps.body: The report form guides users through mandatory sections: manpower, equipment, materials, safety, WIR status, delays, photos, and attachments.
productTourSteps.instruction: Standardized mandatory fields prevent incomplete daily reports and ensure every record includes attendance, progress, safety, WIR status, and photo evidence.

productTourSteps.title: See report outcomes
productTourSteps.body: A completed report triggers approval tasks, PDF export, email distribution, dashboard updates, and permanent audit archiving.
productTourSteps.instruction: Field work becomes management evidence: a completed report updates approval queues, generates distribution, refreshes KPIs, and creates an audit trail.

productTourSteps.title: Manage approval decisions
productTourSteps.body: Approvers see report, material, document, and invoice requests with route, SLA, status, and action buttons.
productTourSteps.instruction: Every approval includes reject-with-reason, 24-hour reminders, 48-hour escalation, delegation options, and a full audit trail.

productTourSteps.title: Track inventory across stores
productTourSteps.body: The module separates central warehouses and project site stores so managers can see where stock is held before it is issued or consumed.
productTourSteps.instruction: The business no longer needs separate store ledgers to know what is in each warehouse or site.

productTourSteps.title: Review stock by location
productTourSteps.body: Consumable materials and tools show total, reserved, available, current location, and status across warehouse and site locations.
productTourSteps.instruction: Approved requests reserve quantities immediately to prevent double-issue before the Store Keeper processes physical stock movement.

productTourSteps.title: Locate tools and items
productTourSteps.body: Asset-tagged tools show their current warehouse or site, project assignment, condition, status, and last movement.
productTourSteps.instruction: Every asset-tagged tool has a current location, project assignment, and condition status so the company always knows where equipment is and whether it is available.

productTourSteps.title: Approve issue or transfer
productTourSteps.body: Issue and transfer requests move through approval before the Store Keeper updates stock and current location.
productTourSteps.instruction: Every issue and transfer creates an audit record, updates location, and prevents stock from going negative or tools from going missing.

productTourSteps.title: Handle controlled documents
productTourSteps.body: Documents include type, project, revision, approval status, active or superseded versioning, and searchable metadata.
productTourSteps.instruction: Field teams always see the approved active version while managers retain complete revision history, superseded warnings, and approval evidence.

productTourSteps.title: See document governance
productTourSteps.body: Document governance covers upload, review, active release, superseded warnings, and expiry reminders.
productTourSteps.instruction: Document control goes beyond file storage: it enforces versioning, approval gates, expiry tracking, and active or superseded rules.

productTourSteps.title: Capture photo evidence
productTourSteps.body: Photos are limited, compressed, watermarked, queued for offline upload, and recoverable by Admin.
productTourSteps.instruction: Photos are linked to daily reports and stored with watermarks, compressed display versions, and original files for audit-ready project records.

productTourSteps.title: See financial control
productTourSteps.body: Finance covers budget versus actual, manpower cost, pending payments, invoices, payment status, and project profit and loss.
productTourSteps.instruction: Cost visibility connects directly to field reports, material consumption, documents, and approval records.

productTourSteps.title: Trace invoice to P&L
productTourSteps.body: Invoices move from capture to accounts check, Operation Manager approval, payment status, and project cost rollup.
productTourSteps.instruction: The finance workflow tracks invoices from accounts capture through OM approval to project cost rollup, with OCR and full accounting added in later phases.

productTourSteps.title: See alerts and reminders
productTourSteps.body: Notifications drive action for pending approvals, late reports, low stock, and active document updates.
productTourSteps.instruction: The system actively drives work forward through notifications and reminders instead of depending on manual WhatsApp or email follow-up.

productTourSteps.title: Govern users and audit logs
productTourSteps.body: Admin can manage users and inspect audit logs while approved reports and historical identities remain protected.
productTourSteps.instruction: Users are deactivated rather than deleted to preserve identity history. Admin overrides are logged with reason and timestamp. Approved reports cannot be silently edited.

productTourSteps.title: See governance controls
productTourSteps.body: The portal preserves identity history, controls overrides, and keeps queryable audit evidence for sensitive actions.
productTourSteps.instruction: Enterprise governance is built in from day one: identity history preservation, override logging, queryable audit trails, and protected approved records.

productTourSteps.title: See the field mobile flow
productTourSteps.body: The phone preview shows site users saving updates, queueing photos, and syncing when the connection allows.
productTourSteps.instruction: The mobile experience is designed for construction sites: compact forms, offline drafts, photo capture with upload queue, and sync when connectivity returns.

productTourSteps.title: Understand offline execution
productTourSteps.body: Mobile behavior covers offline drafts, camera capture, photo queue, sync, autosave, approvals, and active document view.
productTourSteps.instruction: Site teams can save drafts, capture photos, and view documents offline. Everything syncs automatically when the network returns.

productTourSteps.title: Close with delivery confidence
productTourSteps.body: Delivery covers hosting, environments, deployment, backups, testing, migration, and acceptance scenarios.
productTourSteps.instruction: The delivery plan connects directly to implementation: hosting, environments, deployment pipeline, backup strategy, testing matrix, and data migration.

walkthroughSteps.title: Create project baseline
walkthroughSteps.detail: Admin/Operation Manager creates project, BOQ, milestones, members, and deadlines.

walkthroughSteps.title: Supervisor submits field update
walkthroughSteps.detail: Attendance, work location, OT, progress, safety, and five site photos are captured.

walkthroughSteps.title: Engineer verifies and submits report
walkthroughSteps.detail: Engineer validates quality/WIR status, adds work summary, and submits official report.

walkthroughSteps.title: Project Manager approves
walkthroughSteps.detail: PM approves, rejects with comments, or lets the system escalate after SLA breach.

walkthroughSteps.title: System updates records
walkthroughSteps.detail: Dashboard, PDF export, email notification, audit log, documents, and costs update.
